scope: Metadata-only; contains hashes, counts, source classes, and split identities; no dialogue text, prompts, names, credentials, or PHI.

source_origin.origin_basis: generate_edge_case_turn builds prompts only from the hardcoded 10-family taxonomy plus difficulty, ambiguity, and variation; no external seed record or clinical narrative is read for this branch. build_arc_plans._make_seed records edge_cases provenance and ARC generation consumes the local generated transcript.
source_origin.generator_run_provider_model: not recorded in accepted-row provenance, seed map, checkpoint state, or inspected run-log metadata; code accepts environment-selected NF_BACKEND/NF_MODEL. No .env or credential values were inspected.
source_origin.clinical_reviewed_field: auto-set true in generate_edge_case_turn; not treated as proof of actual clinician review, rights, privacy, or clinical validation.
source_origin.rights_interpretation: Internal synthetic prompt construction supports first-party origin for this exact edge branch; the broad proposed source manifest does not independently establish other source classes or blanket external-transfer terms.

generated_run_artifact.limitation: Rows preserve source and scenario metadata but no generator backend/model receipt.

targeted_historical_receipt_search.opencode_session_message_search: Read-only SQLite search over 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-18 for generator script/artifact names and NF_BACKEND/NF_MODEL terms returned zero rows. Three matching rows were dated 2026-10-17 and belonged to current audit context.
targeted_historical_receipt_search.claude_local_logs: No Claude JSON/JSONL/log files were present under /home/vivi/.claude for 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-19.
targeted_historical_receipt_search.foresight_search: Keyword queries for edge generation provider/model returned no historical receipt.
targeted_historical_receipt_search.conclusion: Historical backend/model is not established by targeted local evidence; do not infer from present environment defaults. Further local broad search is not justified absent a new index/artifact.

row_level_reservation.split_method: Stable SHA-256(candidate digest, seed-group digest, fixed g03-edge-v1 salt), 80/10/10 bucket; assignment is groupwise and provisional, not G04-approved.

privacy_regex_screen.limitation: Regex indicator screen only; no raw matches were emitted. It does not detect names or all clinical identifiers. Presidio package is unavailable in this environment; this is a limitation, not proof of absence.

heldout_near_duplicate_screen.method: Per-row unique normalized alphanumeric token 5-gram containment into each heldout rendered prompt; discard ngrams appearing in more than 10/58 prompts. No content output.
heldout_near_duplicate_screen.limitations: Near-duplicate diagnostic only; not semantic equivalence or clinical quality. Golden-control source identities remain missing, though existing full-candidate screen found no control row at >=0.25 containment.

eligibility_gates.met_for_research_subset: Specific first-party synthetic edge seed lineage; exact machine accept metadata and exact archive content binding; 29 heldout-group rows removed; no matches in six basic PII-pattern indicators.
eligibility_gates.not_met_or_not_proven: Actual edge generator provider/model and applicable output-use terms are not recorded in run artifacts; remote provider transfer/use permission must be checked against current provider terms/policy before upload. `clinical_reviewed` is auto-set and cannot support clinical quality claims; production or clinical use is out of scope. Separate lane-2 human review content binding remains unproven.

golden_control_near_duplicate_screen.method: Per-row unique normalized alphanumeric token 5-gram containment into each golden-control rendered prompt; discard grams appearing in more than 10/52 prompts. No content output.
golden_control_near_duplicate_screen.limitations: The control source identities are unavailable; a low-overlap screen cannot establish source independence or semantic separation.
